description: Trace how a prop flows from a source component down through its children, tracking renames and pass-through HOCs. An empty flow means the prop is missing, never forwarded, or forwarded through a pattern the tracer cannot follow (spreads into unknown components, render props, context) — the response note disambiguates; it does NOT prove the prop is unused. Visualize afterwards with visualize_trace_flow (flowType: "prop").

propName.description: Name of the prop to trace through the component tree

sourceFile.description: Absolute path to the source component file where the prop originates

name: get_prop_flow
